## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Creates a protected fund for families with newborns, with an annual city contribution equivalent to 3 cents per $100 of taxable property value. Uses existing property-tax revenue rather than automatically increasing the tax rate. Funds cannot replace existing newborn funding or be transferred to unrelated purposes.

**Original recommendation: LEAN YES.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-i).
